A.NOAA Geomagnetic Activity Observation and Forecast

The greatest observed 3 hr Kp over the past 24 hours was 4 (below NOAA Scale levels).
The greatest expected 3 hr Kp for Jan 06-Jan 08 2025 is 5.00 (G1).

NOAA Kp index breakdown Jan 06-Jan 08 2025

             Jan 06       Jan 07       Jan 08
00-03UT       3.33         3.67         3.00
03-06UT       5.00 (G1)    3.33         2.67

Rationale: A coronal hole high speed stream is now expected to arrive earlier
than previously forecast.

B. NOAA Solar Radiation Storm Forecast for Jan 06-Jan 08 2025

Solar Radiation Storm Forecast for Next 3 Days:
                  Jan 06  Jan 07  Jan 08
S1 or greater        45%     30%     10%

Rationale: A CME associated with an M-class flare observed on 05 Jan is now
expected to arrive early on 06 Jan, raising the chance of an S1 (Minor)
radiation storm well above the prior forecast.

C. NOAA Radio Blackout Forecast for Jan 06-Jan 08 2025

Radio Blackout Forecast for Jan 06-Jan 08 2025
             Jan 06       Jan 07       Jan 08
R1-R2           50%          35%          20%
R3 or greater   15%           5%           5%

Rationale: Continued flare activity is expected from the same active region.
